title: chore: delete everything on master that no longer runs
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Rewrote APIDOCS.md, linked from text.pollinations.ai, around Free API Classic's text and image endpoints, limits, 402 options, feed and caching behavior, best-effort service, terms, and tagged links to Enter. Shortened README.md to describe master's role serving the two cache Workers. Removed about 190,000 lines across 805 files that this branch no longer uses, including old copies of services maintained on main, one-off image-cache export scripts, and workflows that cannot run from this branch. Removed the Hacktoberfest 2025 apps and their deploy workflows together; apps already hosted on Cloudflare Pages remain online. Kept externally linked CONTRIBUTING.md and funding.json, backend-tests.yml, and the VM services, cache Workers, and shared code they import. Text and image cache tests pass.

Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, with chunky retro sprites, a soft pastel gradient background, and warm lighting: cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
